name: fix_go_counter_race
description: Fixes a data race on a shared counter, verified by the race detector
prompts: Count in counter.go increments a shared int from n goroutines with no synchronization - a data race that the race detector flags and that loses updates under load. Fix counter.go so Count(n, per) always returns exactly n*per and is race-free (a sync.Mutex around the increment, or sync/atomic - your choice). Keep the function signature.
